# Ricky Khamis | EPiQ Lending

> Ricky Khamis is President of EPiQ Lending (EVO Home Loans, LLC dba EPiQ Lending, NMLS #1936984), a Certified Mortgage Planner (NMLS #173141), 82nd Airborne veteran, author of Just Win The Day, and host of the Life Mastery Unleashed podcast. Office: 7975 N. Hayden Road, Suite A-101, Scottsdale, AZ 85258. Phone (480) 999-9842. Lending since 1999. Licensed in AZ, CA, CO, FL, NV, TX, UT, IN. Serves Scottsdale, Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Queen Creek, Tempe and all of Arizona.
